notes.title: 2025/08/28 Update
notes.content:
v2.3 Updated: Cursed Apostle

New Class: Hela the Soul Reaper
- The Abyssal Blade Wields: Redemption Through Destruction. Hela, the Soul Reaper, has been unleashed.

New Soul Core Series: Cthulhu Awakens
- Four new Cthulhu Soul Cores with two new affinities:
The King in Yellow + The Pope of Yellow Wind
The Highest Mother + The Sleeping Secret Daughter

New Treasure Hunt Gameplay
- Divine Demise
Inheritors can challenge Divine Demise solo, where Abyssal Overlord Modgud guards mysterious treasures.

New Soul Core: The Apostle of Silver Veils
- A new Physical-based, versatile Mythic Soul Core: ""The Apostle of Silver Veils"" is now available.
This Soul Core can equip a substitute Soul Core from the initial star level, inheriting part of its panel stat and second-slot passive skill.

New Soul Core Cultivation: Attunement
- The new Attunement Upgrade is now available for Soul Core cultivation, consuming Soul Core Fragment and Attunement Brightstone.

New Function: Skill Loadout
- Inheritors can apply recommended skill builds from the system or top players.

Cultivation
- Soul Core level cap increased to 150, advancement level cap expanded from 11 to 20, with no change in material costs.
- New Runes and Rune Whisper added.
- Optimized the strength of some Ice Soul Cores.
- New Mythic gear, Enchant items and new Immortal gear for exchange.

Gameplay Expansion
- Chapters Primglory 6-5 and Vortex of Origin 1-5 are now available.
- New Level 60 (60) Hero Co-op and Caravan Co-op dungeons added, featuring new gear, new Enchants, and more.
- Clearing the Vortex of Origin now grants new rewards: Soul Essence items.

Optimization
- Caravan: Added Caravan renaming and Leader transfer, and more Vice Leader slots.
- The screen will no longer turn off while the game is running.
- Added a ""Claim All"" feature for Daily Quest rewards.
...and various other improvements...

notes.title: 2025/07/03 Update
notes.content:
v2.2 Updated: The Dusky Bloodline

New Class - Chaos the Warrior
- This advanced class unlocks at level 25. ""Chaos the Warrior"" joins the battle wielding hammer-based, strike-focused weapons and skills.

New Game Mode - Astral Expedition
- Astral Expedition: A time-limited mode where Inheritors can form squads within their Caravan to challenge a brand-new boss — Darkvein Adiposer.

New Soul Core - Frozen Illusion of Divinity
- A brand-new Ice elemental, Soul Core “Balder The God of Light” is now available. It provides stable critical damage and solo Affinity, boosting all team attributes. The Supreme version drops exclusively from the time-limited Astral Expedition.
- Ice element Soul Core series is now fully added, including
“Loki The Evil,” “Cthylla The Frostwyrm,” “Kraken The Sea Monster,” and “Hydra The Deep Diver.”

New Cultivation - Myriad Casket
- Inheritors can now construct four Ancient affixes and preserve the exclusive affixes from the Mythic equipment, then ascend the Mythic equipment into Immortal Sets.

New Transmog - Crimson Curse of Immortality
- Character sets:
Hela “Crimson Moon Reverie,” Esther “Phantasmal Night's Allure,” Chaos “Lord of Eternal Night”
- Nephesh: “Nightmare Beast”
- Weapons: “Crimsonwing Blade,” “Phantomwing Pistol,” “Scythe of Judgment”

New Chapter - Fragments of Gladsheim
- Chapter Trurem 6-5 unlocks, World Progress, chapter task, Yggdrasil Blessing and more are available.

Optimizations - New Buds on the Yggdrasil
- A new ""Free Cast"" mode has been added; Inheritors can switch controlling modes in the Skill interface.
- A new ""Entity Illusion"" Willpower Leaderboard has been added; Inheritors can check their current Willpower rankings in the Thought Amulet interface.
- New ""Entity Illusion"" option button for sorting Solo/Co-op Silver Keys.
- New ""Entity Illusion"" feature: Skip battles and directly claim rewards from Solo keys tier 1 to 3 (no Privilege required).
- New Mythical Blueprint exchanges have been added to the Campaign Shop.
- Added a preview feature for the Thought Amulet, including estimated Willpower drops.
- Weekly and Monthly Pass daily rewards have been expanded — Inheritors can now choose additional rewards beyond the default ones.
- Improved display of Privileges in both leaderboard and chat interfaces.
- Optimized the main story boss challenges — after death, Inheritors can now use the “Spring of Revival” item to resurrect and continue the battle.
- Improved combat experience for certain class skills (including fixing abnormal skill range issues for Esther and adjusting the combat feel of some skills).
...and many other detailed improvements...

notes.title: V2.2 Update Announcemnet
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/14c8332f4693d250cff15ba2f08592d6e9641c76.png"]

Dear Inheritors:

BOGX v2.2 update – The Dusky Bloodline: Astral Expedition will officially launch on June 11!

This update features a luxurious lineup: new game mode, new class, new Soul Cores, new Transmogs, and new cultivation systems...



The Old Ones whisper forbidden coordinates; the astral dust calls for an expedition 

Fully armed Inheritors...

Will you be able to traverse the stars and conquer the Old Gods?


==== I. New Mode | Astral Expedition ====


Upon returning from the Divine Trial in the Entity Illusion, the Inheritors are unexpectedly transported to a planet covered in a surface resembling muscular tissue — the sealed land of Y'golonac’s Skull.

Here, a manifestation formed of black, viscous fluid is steadily corrupting the seal. To prevent the World Tree from being infected and parasitized, the Inheritors must defeat this entity and reseal it.


[previewyoutube="pcNvTkz1ZLY;full"][/previewyoutube]


✦✦✦ Gameplay Overview ✦✦✦

◇ Inheritors will form 3-player squads within their Caravan to challenge a brand-new boss:
One of the Parasitic Old Ones, the Skin-Splitter of the Corrupted Star Core — the Embodiment of Y'golonac’s Skull: Darkvein Adiposer
◇ Once the battle begins, Darkvein Adiposer will periodically increase its defense and attack, either over time or when receiving a certain amount of damage. Be cautious of its complex and aggressive skills.

◇ During the event, once a squad is formed, players cannot team up with others outside that squad.

◇ Players can challenge unlimited times, and only your highest score will be recorded.

◇ By completing the challenge, players can earn rich rewards, including Squad Point, Caravan Points, Squad Rank, Caravan Rank, and more.

◇ See the full rules and rewards on the "Astral Expedition" page within "Caravan."


==== II. New Control | Free Cast ====

Inheritors can now switch between Free Cast Mode and Skill Chain Mode from the top left corner of the Skills page.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bc985a181e836c00b85b812e2aa4817b414c46c4.jpg"]

◇ In Free Cast Mode, each skill enters its own independent CD after being used, and is no longer affected by the shared cooldown of the skill chain.

◇ However, in Free Cast Mode, the CD of each skill may vary, and the exact values can be viewed directly on the Skills page.

◇ Certain affixes that enhance skill chains (e.g., “Increases damage while the skill chain is on CD”) may partially or not function in Free Cast Mode. For full compatibility details, refer to the "?" icon on the Skills page.


==== III. New Class | Chaos the Warrior ====


Wielding a mighty warhammer to crush all evil, this formidable new class features numerous super armor skills (with both Ice and Fire elements) and can enhance teammates' ATK.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/95b99bf5512945118ac920cf31a213dad6a7a50c.png"]

An intrepid warrior born of noble lineage, Chaos is said to have held back the enemy, spilling his last drop of blood on the battlefield between humanity and the Fallen Gods to cover the retreat of the human allied forces. Hailing from the "Black Wolf" clan of the Human Royal City, Chaos descends from ancestors who once encountered Odin, the King of the Gods. From this union sprang offspring bearing divine blood, bestowing extraordinary power upon their descendants through their very veins.


==== IV. New Soul Core | Frozen Illusion of Divinity ====


◇ New Ice Soul Core Now Available!
[previewyoutube="BORg1TN2sVs;full"][/previewyoutube]
1. Loki The Evil (Mythic) & Frigg The Star Goddess (Primal)

After activating Affinity, you can manually refresh all skill CDs and gain high Crit rates and Ice Elemental ATK increases.



2. Cthylla The Frostwyrm (Primal) & Casias The Ancient King (Legendary)

Grants a significant final DMG bonus and DMG reduction. When triggering Cthylla's Active Soul Skill, it also reduces the target's Ice Resistance.



3. Kraken The Sea Monster (Primal) & Grid The Black Coffin (Epic)

Provides a high Crit rate. When attacking enemies affected by Ice debuffs, deals increased DMG. Triggering the Kraken's active Soul Skill further boosts your Crit DMG significantly.



4. Hydra The Deep Diver (Primal) & Isis The Diviner (Epic)

Increases great CD reduction. When facing monster crowds, the Deep Diver's Active Soul Skill also has a crowd-control (pulling) effect.



◇ Balder The God of Light

When Hel, Goddess of the Underworld, pronounced her oracle: "Only an ocean of mortal tears can redeem the Light," Balder's silver coffin was left suspended atop Yggdrasil. Prophecy foretells: When decayed roots sprout anew, he shall return, wielding an emerald branch and treading upon an ocean of cries.
[previewyoutube="VjovVCz_XfU;full"][/previewyoutube]
The Affinity can be activated independently and grants a high boost to both Crit DMG and elemental DMG. Participate in Astral Expedition to win the Superme version by chance!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/26ed3c31aabb9c12fdc0f21c63d5aaedd3eae284.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/7dfbd9274d33541cb177bab1330acc8db9c640a4.png"]
==== V. New Transmog | Crimson Curse of Immortality ====


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/1b2a5fb430d8adc2b0d0f54a3677006dba289a42.png"]Hela - Crimson Moon Reverie



As the Blood Moon stains the withered branches of the World Tree, the blade entwines with the Eternal Night Rose.

When she strikes down the starlight, her fangs and sword gleam in unison — a dual requiem of Norse valkyries and the progenitor of the bloodline.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/59bdb57186b9ad9a4250d6b5ccd5f03ef9386a3f.png"]Esther - Phantasmal Night's Allure



When the veil of night is torn by gunfire, starlight seeps through the gown.

As she pulls the trigger, rose-tinted smoke and bloodline sorcery entwine—the bullet’s path curves like the vines of a Night Rose, blooming under moonlight with a deadly, graceful arc.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/4d9299eb132037b82a3357b46e748b5881981ae9.png"]Chaos - Lord of Eternal Night



When the stars extinguish their final glimmer, the scythe carves through the veil of eternal night.

With each swing, dark matter surges like a living cloak—every scythe dance tears open miniature black holes, as if the Abyss itself were wielding the power of harvest.


==== VI. New Cultivation | Myriad Casket ====


While battling the Darkvein Adiposer in the depths of the astral sea, Inheritors unexpectedly obtained the “Myriad Casket”—an artifact that holds a trace of the Thousand-Faced God Nyarlathotep.Audhum's research revealed that this casket can be powered using rare materials from the starry abyss, allowing it to alter the nature of Mythical gears, and even evolve it beyond its limits into Immortal gears...



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/090b4c7f4f3b96ca17dbe71578736c1a45b60edf.png"]

Inheritors can consume Starmoire Crystal to individually construct Ancient Affixes on a designated Mythical item. Once satisfied with a specific affix, it can be locked, preventing further rerolling. Locking an affix unlocks the next slot. After constructing and locking all four affixes, you can consume a Pyre Script to ascend the item into an Immortal gear, gaining unique powerful bonuses.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ad05a05d6d4ebf93781c7cc94c29ffbcafa18c99.png"]

Both Starmoire Crystal and Pyre Script can be obtained through the Astral Expedition. 

For detailed rules, please refer to the "?" icon in Myriad Casket.


==== VII. Optimizations + Others ====

[olist]
Chapter Trurem 6-5 unlocks, World Progress, chapter task, Yggdrasil Blessing and more are available

A new  Willpower Leaderboard has been added; Inheritors can check their current Willpower rankings in the Thought Amulet interface

Optimized and enhanced passive skill for the Warriors

Optimized the combat feel of skills and fixed abnormal skill range issues for Esther

Improved skill performance and hit feedback for certain classes

Improved display of Privileges in both leaderboard and chat interfaces

Privilege Level Cap Expanded

Weekly and Monthly Pass daily rewards have been expanded — Inheritors can now choose additional rewards beyond the default ones

Optimized the UI design for several interfaces

Improved performance in co-op battles

Optimized device compatibility for certain mobile models

New Entity Illusion option button for sorting Solo/Co-op Silver Keys

Added a filter for Yellow Sign in the Backpack > Equipment DISAM feature

Players can still continue the level once being defeated by Invader (the red hand) in main story

After death, Inheritors can use the “Spring of Revival” to resurrect and continue the Boss battle in main story

Optimized certain newbie tutorials and feature guidance steps

Thought Amulet preview feature added, including estimated Willpower drops

Entity Illusion would be unlocked once Voidom 5-2 finished

Skip battles in Entity Illusion and directly claim rewards from Solo keys tier 1 to 3 (no Privilege required)

Added a clear sign on the Skill page to show the “Cost -1” attribute

Increased mailbox capacity, and new mails will now appear pinned at the top

The maximum number of Life Wedges that can be consumed at once in Soul Core upgrades now grows with the Inheritor’s level

New Mythical Blueprint exchanges have been added to the Campaign Shop

Added Level Support Pack and Deluxe Level Support Pack to the Soul Jade Shop

notes.title: V2.1 Guide: The Hidden Treasure Chest - Full Star Collecting Maps
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/939dcc999e10df561d78bf2cd78633782f4483e3.png
Introduction

In Blade of God, collecting all the chests within each level is a key factor in achieving a three-star rating in the main storyline. Accumulated stars can be exchanged in the Explore Gift section for generous rewards, including large amounts of Soul Stones and Orisols Scrolls.

Some players have reported difficulty locating certain hidden chests in specific levels. To assist with that, we've prepared this illustrated guide to help you track down all hidden chests and ensure a full clear.

Voidom
3-4 Underground
There are a total of 8 chests at this level. The map is large. If you're unsure where to go, refer to this map to help guide your direction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/be97649637c642751c6c5c0918dae10acb3da00b.png

From the Initial Point, head to the right. You'll find the first chest in front of a coffin. Next, turn right again and walk behind the rocks to discover the second chest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/033f711350fbfc4042c35679e9c76f4fedf9ea0c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/32c173fbc44956a55f7738b5ea040bb1a12e4a3d.png
Return to the Initial Point, and you’ll find the third chest next to a skeleton just ahead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/1a5bf4196ee4c1268f5db22fc8d2d08decafd7c5.png

Move behind the skeleton, and behind the rock on the rear left side, you’ll locate the fourth chest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/845ac0fd53a77cb3a7649484f0c47a9df2c7ceb3.png
Turn around and walk straight back, you'll spot the fifth chest ahead. Keep moving forward through the fog, and you’ll come across two more chests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/97a45e1c52d6f1d2c4f8118f52a7d1546499ec48.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/9848c78cd008278bce62aead1497ecea0d23b035.png
Finally, turn around and walk straight to the end of the path. Once you reach the mushroom forest, turn left—you’ll find the eighth and final chest hidden inside.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/49117e93f3c45e5d7e53e19a0a92a9b5d176ed99.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/16ab8f598756946cd74a2c472752ee6d45460f54.png
4-3 Black Tomb
There are a total of 4 chests at this level. Right behind the Initial Point, you'll find the first chest hidden behind a mushroom.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/a181952d9a8d319d8d8c5838c0bccef60662d5e7.png
Continue moving forward, next to the Hugroots, you’ll find the second chest. Keep going ahead and walk through the fog.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/991ca96b25ddfb94c93c1b35ac5556dd7c1944dc.png
After passing through the fog, the third chest ahead. Then, head into the fog on the right.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/560080fdc80874af92bb0c7b3e65ecf545275a26.png

Once through, you can find the fourth chest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/cac31983ea141e8eebd9dca7531bd1fe91022e1b.png
4-4 Dark Forest
There are total of 5 chests in the level, and you can refer this map to help you find the direction. The first chest in front of the Initial Point.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/c464747713bdb6be666c28a24a4c1e5a204d0499.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/e73d5fb5c07bea145ca20b5ccbbe842906243868.png

Continue following the path and you'll come across the second chest. Then, take a left turn onto the narrow trail on the left side.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/aa82b2946619d6992dbe4b06cfeb670fa486c279.png
In front of the Hugroots, you’ll find one chest. Then pass the Hugroots and turn left to find a chest further ahead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/c08e3ae781d3536d8ee7586acf4388abad506d4d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/6c2d2259f8a929a5443ae417a4368e07a6d46b29.png
Keep walking forward. In the clearing at the far end, you’ll find the fifth chest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/c22f65c92b768f59d20d143522a1324176e5bb72.png
5-1 Brave Gate
There are total of five chests in the level, there are two chests in front of Initial Point.

notes.title: V2.1 Guide: Advanced Cultivation - High Crit Based On Soul Cores & Gears
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bf2f7557d33db88c521fab3fcde31492229a0f18.png

Four Elemental Debuffs

How do you release all four elemental debuffs effects to the enemies? It’s easy in co-op mode, each teammate has a weapon of a different element to cover all four. In solo mode, you’ll always trigger your primary-element debuff but still need the other three. 

You can rely on your armor’s ancient affix [when you cast a skill, having a chance to apply a random elemental debuff to the target], but it is too random, a more reliable way is to take different Soul Cores of each elemental debuff (using Soul Core Substitution function to preserve affinity completion), and then use their Skill 1's elemental damage to apply the debuffs. Here are a few Soul Cores that are renowned for their strong sole capabilities:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/59594dcf9928ab5a48f0356cd1dee385c38b8833.png

Fire: The Dragon of the End (Mythic) and The Bombardment (Primal) both have the same skill 2 Extreme Blade, which boosts your ATK, making them incredibly versatile and easy to slot into almost any build.
Ice: The Deep Diver (Primal) delivers massive CD reduction in the early stage, letting you cycle light-and-heavy-weapon skills easily. The Deep Diver will lose elemental-damage boost on Skill 2, but their other benefits are enough to make up for that trade-off.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/85ac06734ca01f4dff2f7008155f7c82e5e44bec.png

Thunder: The Allfather (Mythic) and The Immortal (Primal), both “Odin” variants with broad applicability. The Allfather is the essensial for crit-based builds based on its third-skill’s huge critical-damage buff, while The Immortal gives you Extreme Blade on Skill 2 and a general elemental improves on Skill 3, so it very worthy to take.
Poison: The Monster Wolf (Mythic), The Wise One (Primal), Ymir Shell (Primal), and The Goddess of Youth (Mythic). Monster Wolf and Wise One both have Extreme Blade on Skill 2, Ymir Shell is essential for triggering crit, and Goddess of Youth offers sustained recovery, which is suitable for the early stage.

Summary: Take The Dragon of the End, The Deep Diver, The Allfather, and Ymir Shell to reliably trigger all four elemental debuffs.

Other Soul Core Choices

- The God of the Moon. Lezard: As an essential Poisonous Soul Core, previous guide pointed out that Poisonous Core suffered from a lack of DMG reduced RES, but now with Lezard filling that gap。 I’ll revisit full Poisonous core recommendation in more detail later.
- The Moderator & The Goddess of Fertility: Both received a enhancement to their Skill 1 damage, just be aware that their skill range is fairly small, so you’ll want to release them right next to your target for maximum effect.

Gears & Sets Suggestions 

Abstract: Optional upgrade; not mandatory.

“Chalky Sacred” Set

This set is got from the “Warrior Co-op: Cold Ice. Ancestor Shell” dungeon, Level 60(40). 

Its four-piece bonus grants +15 % Critical Rate and +40 % Critical Damage; and, its base stats as same as the previous version’s Level 60 (10) Melted Iron Best-in-Slot gear, with the sole addition of 16 % All-elemental Damage Reduction. Consider the current version, pervasive damage overflow, this set is by no means a required upgrade. However, if you already possess three Mythic or Immortal gear with the “Set-1” affix, you may consider replacing the fourth piece with a Chalky Sacred gear to secure the extra Crit Damage boost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/022fd2d8a2e82f3995054ab9d71e8824d735a23b.jpg

“Blood Spirit Oath” Set

Got from the (Warrior Co-op – Thunderstorms. Skoll) dungeon, Level 60(40). 

Its four-piece bonus grants +5 % Attack and +22 % All Elemantal DMG. Although this set sounds generally useful, now we already have Twisted Meteor and Abyssal Prism, which increase higher sustain and DMG. The Nephesh slot is replaced by the Mythic Thunder Spirit Fox, offering extreme increasing skill-damage, and the skill level improve. So, the Blood Spirit Oath Set sees almost no use once those alternatives are available and is recommended only as a short-term choise for new players until they secure Best-in-Slot gear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/0758a743731ecabeba79c96e11b1a7ab6ded0eff.jpg

Mythic Gear

Abstract: It is recommended to reroll weapon affixes to optimize their attributes.

Light and Heavy Weapons
- Compared to the previous version, the basic fixed affixes have received only marginal increases—insufficient to affect overall balance.

However, this update introduces a new ancient affix which changed the game:

Light Weapons (Best-in-Slot Affix Combination): Critical Damage increase, Critical Damage increase Against Debuffed Targets ,Light Weapon Skill Level Increase.
Heavy Weapons (Best-in-Slot Affix Combination): Critical Damage increase, Heavy Weapon Skill Level Increase, Attack or Elemental Damage increase.

Chaos Slot

- In high-output scenarios, Storm Heart outperforms Twisted Meteor.
- Although Twisted Meteor was the Best-in-Slot chaos in the previous version, based on its exceptional sustain. However, by the introduction of the Talent—Fearless Warrior and unlocked cooldown-reduction attributes has greatly eased sustained concerns.
- So, Storm Heart can be chosen as a transitional choice until you get higher-tier Immortal chaos.

Immortal Gear

Abstract: Strongly recommend to choose and rerolling the affixes.

Chaos Slot – Abyssal Prism
- Its permanent Critical Damage increase is very useful in the current version, where cooldown pressure is no longer an issue in the current version.
- For players with insufficient Critical Rate, its 18 % Critical Rate increase is also useful.
Recommended Affixes: Increases skill damage when releasing skills, Increases critical rate and critical damage upon entering combat” (new in this version).

Soul Core Build Recommendations for Each Elemental Style

For detailed strategies, please read my previous guide. This summary follows the same foundation; the only adjustment is to choose new Soul Cores based on your current Crit Rate (e.g., have you over 100%?). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/e8bb767d5df0efb2eb3b67d4dafb0e394958f6d4.png

Fire Soul Core Affinities

notes.title: V2.1 Guide: Soul Stone Strategy - Over 30000 In Month One
notes.content:

First of all
This guide will take you through the way you can get Soul Stone as a beginner in the first month, ensuring you maximize your game efficiency and get Soul Stone as much as possible.

Tips: Before we begin, I strongly recommend that all new players master the main story mode and level up to 60. Completing the main story mode not only unlocks new features and dungeons but also obtains lots of Soul Stone rewards.

Powering the Main Story Mode and Level Up

1. Explore Gift

When you are clearing the main story quests, you must notice there are some treasure boxes on the map. Try to explore the map and open all the boxes to earn a three-star rating, which is essential for your Explore Gifts. By the time you unlock Voidom Chapter 6-5, usually right around level 60 in your first month. You can get at least 3910 Soul Stones from Explore Gift if you've earned 180 stars in previous chapters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/27e9d115466da6c07cee1328484f88c6bcb903e7.jpg

2. World Stat Award

You can award 2300 Soul Stones in total from world stats. After you complete Voidom chapters 2-5 and 4-5 each grants 500 and 1000 Soul Stones. And completing Primglory chapter 1-5 for another 800 Soul Stones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/b6d5a4ebd901901ca47d693e4812b13f10d1b367.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ed1398c5b085e935a03319bb3a0a315d2f89a2e4.jpg

3. Level Fund

Don’t forget the Level Fund in your Mail. Reaching level 60 awards 600 Soul Stones (12 tiers × 50 stones each). After level 60, additional tiers unlock more stones—claim them as soon as they become available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ac66b2f99c08906b9971df7c7f62c3fc225f1c61.jpg

Summary: Following the main story queatline and hitting level 60 within your first month, you'll get at least 6810 Soul Stones.

Tasks and dungeons

1. Daily Task

Every day in Blade of God X you have a chance to earn Soul Stones. Completing daily tasks grants 150 Soul Stones. I recommend farming the daily dungeon first to quickly boost your activity, then returning to the quest menu to claim your rewards. In the early stages, before all dungeons are unlocked, replaying main-story chapters also fills your activity effectively.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ae03b074d18ff2314da3ec3e28279b8d93c75212.jpg

2. Battle Pass Daily Quests

While completing Daily Quests, you’ll simultaneously tick off your Battle Pass daily quests. You earn 120 Soul Stones once your daily reputation reaches 400, and push that Battle Pass all the way to level 76 within the month, and you’ll have another 320 stones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/8e2b994ca2f32dfe0f6e118c8c2cacd6f72cf2c5.jpg

3. God Arena

Once the Book of Adventure unlocks the God Arena, you can earn Soul Stones there. You have three challenges per day, each awarding 20–50 stones depending on the level you choose. I recommend new players start with levels 1 and 2 for practice and only attempt level 3 once you are familiar with it.
Each level of God Arena has its own leaderboard. You can try to crack the top 5000 rank on each one and get 300 stones per season (two weeks), for a total of 900 stones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/46044b4d76fb9a0dbebbc37d3e9e25d2287e931d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/265ce4a2ad10f09ccc855c3128f0eadc98509965.jpg

4. Two Souls

As a new player, you won’t spend much time in Two Souls; just play a few rounds and make sure you are in the top 9999 rank. Every season (two weeks) rewards 50 Soul Stones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/45d16cc994347d9a161b671c0099f60f950acc11.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/36dcb001f1ff7b5d6c94ee763372c9936041d106.jpg

5. Old Arena

Meanwhile, Old Arena as a daily task—ten victories will quickly push you into Platinum rank, and Platinum rewards 225 Soul Stones, and a season rewards of 400 stones

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/4f4fc4e4953c98325e5595f6f5dc7807440d7298.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/b4bf96cb90830deb230fb7290a01720345cb2aa1.jpg

6. Combat Training

Don’t forget the Combat Training in Book of Adventure; the first clear on each chapter can get 275 stones in total.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/985e2e69ccccbb90d757dc505121fd33817edc7e.jpg


Summary: Putting it all together, you can get a total of 420 Soul Stones every day from daily tasks, Battle Pass daily quests, and God Arena. Add in your monthly season rewards, 1,800 Soul Stones from God Arena rank, 100 Soul Stones from Two Souls rank, and 313 Soul Stones from the Old Arena, and you’re looking at over 15,300 Soul Stones just in ONE MONTH!!!!

Events and Daily Check-In

1. Check-In

Each day you log in to the game, you can claim your daily check-in reward. If you sign in for 28 days in a month, you will receive 600 Soul Stones.

Join the official Telegram or WhatsApp community groups to claim 100 Soul Stones, and don’t forget to subscribe to the game on Steam and leave a comment for another 50 stones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/b8880844fa01b09e13db23b404b2e6d2b1c6235f.jpg

Top-up

To unlock Orisols pass, you can get another 2400 Soul Stones when you pass level reaching 76.

Obtaining a weekly pass can receive 1000 Soul Stones every week.

notes.title: V2.1 Guide: Entity Illusion - Battle Strategy & Item Guide
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/20959566ca346a6c1f9ba6d65888e7d6ac4cf2b8.png
PART 1: Gameplay

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/1ccba38810a0d068761fb00e68ec5f58944163b3.jpg
Entity Illusion can be summarized as a cyclical challenge system:
★Use a Key → Complete a battle → Get the Key for the Next Level → Repeat★
During the cycle, entering a challenge requires meeting a Willpower threshold, which can be increased by collecting Thought Amulet.
Yellow Signs are the ultimate pursuit in this gameplay, as this gear's stats apply across all game modes. They also have a chance to contain rare and powerful affixes, helping Inheritors boost both Power and damage.

PART 2: Items

Silver Keys serve as tickets to the Entity Illusion and come in two types:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/540681161591ee0a0ebcf2ba866b07cbdc741e4b.jpg
✦ Solo Tickets: Usable only by yourself; have a chance to drop a key for the next level.
✦ Co-op Tickets: You can invite up to two friends to join. Only the host’s ticket is consumed, and no tickets drop in this mode.
Also, if you fail the challenge, don't worry—the ticket is returned to the Inheritor who didn't complete it.

PART 3: Suggestions

1. Low-Tier levels Farming Tips

Since the ticket drop to the next level is probability-based, it's common to experience ticket shortages around level 3 or 4. This means you’ll need to frequently farm low-tier levels. Solo tickets often require defeating many small mobs, so here are a few ways to improve combat efficiency:

- Enemy Gathering Skills or Soul Cores:
Using enemy gathering skills significantly increases efficiency at low levels.
▶ For example, the Devil Lord’s light weapon skill "Soul Reaping Rift".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/70a30716e27ff8035137046cf9de124a098702c8.jpg
- ▶ If you're playing another class without enemy gathering skills, you can use Soul Cores for the same effect; like the “Jormungand. the Mortal Snake” Soul Core. Since Soul Cores don’t provide Willpower and early levels aren’t damage-demanding, you can equip this Soul Core in the first skill or light weapon breaking slot without worrying too much about cultivation.

- Ultra:
Low-tier mobs can usually be cleared from a single Ultra skill, so increasing Ultra frequency boosts farming speed.
▶ Watch for dropped gear with affixes like "Reduced Ultra Energy Requirement", "Faster Ultra Charge", or "Increased Ultra Damage".
▶ Use the Affinity: Audhum + Surtr (level 4). This Affinity allows you to release two Ultras at the beginning of the battle, clearing mobs instantly.
- On certain levels, elite mobs turn into hamster balls to assist you after defeat—consider prioritizing them.

2. High-Tier Level Tips

- Remodel Sign Affixes:
The higher the level, the lower the chance to drop the next level’s key. Once you get a high-tier solo ticket (Stage 5+ recommended), consider remodeling its affixes:
▶ Go to the main gameplay screen (green interface with keyhole), tap the bottom-left icon to open the Silver Key inventory. Select a Silver Key, then click REMODEL’ to consume Yellow Signs and remodel affixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/6365eeef57add0779fdbccc6326ec2bfc2f6bb26.jpg
▶ For solo tickets, prioritize affixes that boost Silver Key drops.
▶ If you have a lot of Yellow Signs, you can remodel them for key drop affixes. Once the remodel result is good, use Infusion to enhance affixes values using shards gained from dismantling Amulets.

3. Team Challenge Tips

Since co-op tickets can't drop tickets to the next level, consider refining affixes of Yellow Signs or Thought Amulet drops instead.
- If your Willpower is low and you can’t enter mid-to-high level stages, focus on refining the Amulet affixes.
- If your Willpower is decent, refine Yellow Sign drop affixes more.

Extra Tips:

- If you have enough Amulet shards, max out your affixes values.
- Since only the host consumes the ticket, consider each player of the 3 provide the ticket rotately to maximize efficiency—or even use alt accounts to provide tickets and farm faster.

PART 4: Yellow Signs – Efficient Power & Damage Cultivation

1. Collecting Yellow Signs

- Early stage, use Epic (purple) Yellow Signs as a temporary choice.
- Affixes Priority: Focus on DMG and Final DMG. If your Crit Rate isn’t at 100%, put priority on Crit Rate too.
- Goal: Primal Yellow Signs can contain the best affixes—Skill Damage Increase—which should be your primary collection target.
- Tip: Some affixes have negative values (like resistance or elemental damage). These stats are naturally high, so a slight decrease won’t hurt your power much.

2. Yellow Sign Synthesis

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/4b3a23fc4efd920a8bb20bdf5b4694b012f362d0.png
- Be cautious, when the Yellow Sign Synthesises. Synthesis only re-combines existing affixes—it doesn’t generate new ones.
- Note: Both parent Signs need to have good affixes. Synthesis carries risk, so keep a usable backup Sign in case the result isn't ideal, or your power might be affected.

Dear Inheritors,
In order to provide players with a better gaming experience and improve the playability and interactivity of the game, we will launch the server update at 13:00PM, April 9th (UTC + 8), with an expected shutdown of 4 hours. 

After the shutdown update ends, Inheritors can receive the following update reward through in-game emails:

I. New Character Esther
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/ac55b7ce56bbce88aa868080b8e5300039a662cc.png
Unlike Chaos and Hela, Esther is a character with long-range offensive capabilities.
As a Valkyrie who wields firearms to deal damage from a distance, Esther offers a gameplay experience that emphasizes mobility and strategy.
The two newly unlocked classes for this character further diversify the play-style based on the foundation of her long-range combat template; providing a fresh and unique battle experience!

Basic Class [Hunter]
As a Valkyrie, Hunter Esther wields dual guns that can deal damage to large groups of targets, and after completing specific skills, she can perform a teleportation.
The Hunter primarily deals multi-segment physical damage to enemies.

Advanced Class [The Saint]
Esther is not only a noble and beautiful envoy but also a Valkyrie walking the mortal world. Therefore, based on this concept, Esther's golden armor, while maintaining its firm and solemn foundation, incorporates feather-like plates, which transform soft feathers into sharp protective weapons, further emphasizing her identity as a Valkyrie.
The Saint's heavy weapon is a handheld cannon, mainly inflicting Thunder, Fire, and minor physical damage, suitable for continuous area damage.

II. New Game Mode: Entity Illusion & Related Cultivation System

1.Gameplay Introduction
Entity Illusion has 11 levels
Inheritors can use the Silver Key to enter a certain level while consume Sainty 
Chances to obtain 'Yellow Signs', 'Thought Amulets', and 'Silver Keys' of higher levels during the battle

2.New Attribute - Willpower
Willpower is the exclusive attribute in Entity Illusion, to resist the mental corruption caused by unspeakable beings. It is said that when one's mental energy depletes, they will go mad and lose their sanity, ultimately becoming a sacrifice to Cthulhu

3.Items Introduction
✦ Silver Key ✦ 
The treasure condensed from space-time energy at the heart of the World Tree, the Silver Key requires ‘Willpower’ as a prerequisite for use

The Silver Key is divided into 11 tiers, each capable of transporting the user to a corresponding level of Entity Illusion

The Silver Key comes in two types: single-player and multi-player. The multi-player Silver Key allows the holder to invite two other Inheritors to join the battle together, though the enemies within will also become more powerful

Each Silver Key has random affixes (either debuffs or buffs), Inheritors entering the illusion will be affected by these affixes.

----------------------------

✦ Thought Amulet ✦ 
The Blessing of the World Tree can protect iInheritor from the mental attacks of the unspeakable

The attributes of the Thought Amulet only take effect within Entity Illusion

The higher the quality of the Thought Amulet, the greater the Willpower and attribute bonuses it provides.

Thought Amulets are divided into four categories: Attack, Defense, Life, and Omni. Attack, Defense, and Life types can only be equipped in their corresponding slots, while the Omni one can be equipped in all slots

Thought Amulet can be disam into Amulet Fragments

----------------------------

✦ Yellow Signs ✦ 
An artifact imbued with the essence of Hastur grants the wearer terrifying power

The affixes attached to the Yellow Sign may potentially have negative values

The Yellow Sign can carry multiple same affixes

The higher the quality of the Yellow Sign, the more attribute affixes it can carry

4.Other
✦ Silver Key Extraction ✦ 
The random buffs/debuffs of the Silver Key can be refined by using the ‘Yellow Sign’

There is a chance to get affixes which are from additional drops or add an extra affix by refining

Higher-quality Yellow Signs have a greater chance of refining affixes for additional drops and are less likely to transform these affixes into ordinary buffs/debuffs

The Silver Key can simultaneously carry the same additional drop affixes

----------------------------

✦ Silver Key Infusion ✦ 
The Silver Key can be refined using 'Amulet Fragments' obtained by dismantling the 'Thought Amulet.'
After refining, it can increase the drop quantity of certain items

----------------------------

✦ Yellow Sign Synthesis ✦ 
Yellow Signs can be synthesized in pairs
The synthesized Yellow Sign's quality will randomly fluctuate between the qualities of the two material Yellow Signs.
For example, 
synthesizing an Advanced Yellow Sign (blue) with a Primal Yellow Sign (gold) may result in an Advanced Yellow Sign (blue), Epic Yellow Sign (purple), Legendary Yellow Sign (orange), or Primal Yellow Sign (gold). The attributes of the synthesized Yellow Sign will be randomly selected from the attributes of the two material Yellow Signs, with their values remaining unchanged.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/8a9ec989da8fac4b1e1fa741ca381b900fe34714.png

Dear Inheritors,
The brand new game mode —— Entity Illusion will show up in the latest v2.1 update!
Today, we’ll share the real-time in-game PV, background story and gameplay features.
We’ll also be releasing more previews of the upcoming content soon, so stay tuned!

[previewyoutube=uPubdDtXcpA;full][/previewyoutube]
✦✦✦ Background Story ✦✦✦
From the chaotic void emerge those unnameable Outer Gods, silently eroding our world. When tentacles pierce through slumbering R'lyeh's veil, the pallid sacrificial one awakens from the crimson prison. She offers her eyes, transmuting flesh into gem; forging the Silver Key, unlocking the Illusion gate.
Inheritors...
Only by confronting the nameless dread shall you reach salvation.

 ✦✦✦ Gameplay Introduction ✦✦✦
▶  Entity Illusion has 11 levels
▶  Inheritors can use the Silver Key to enter a certain level while consume Sainty
▶  Chances to obtain 'Yellow Signs,' 'Thought Amulets,' and 'Silver Keys' of higher levels during the battle
 
✦✦✦ New Attribute - Willpower ✦✦✦
Willpower is the exclusive attribute in Entity Illusion to resist the mental corruption caused by unspeakable beings. It is said that when one's mental energy depletes, they will go mad and lose their sanity, ultimately becoming a sacrifice to Cthulhu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/6a80cb3d58d8bf9aa56116602d222c43f5f98242.png

 ✦✦✦ Items Introduction ✦✦✦
▶  Silver Key
✦The Silver Key requires 'Willpower' as a prerequisite for use
✦The Silver Key is divided into 11 tiers, each capable of transporting the user to a corresponding level of Entity Illusion
✦The Silver Key comes in two types: single-player and multi-player. The multi-player Silver Key allows the holder to invite two other Inheritors to join the battle together, though the enemies within will also become more powerful
✦Each Silver Key has random affixes (either debuffs or buffs). Inheritors entering the illusion will be affected by these affixes

▶ Thought Amulet
✦The Blessing of the World Tree can protect Inheritor from the mental attacks of the unspeakable
The attributes of the Thought Amulet only take effect within Entity Illusion
✦The higher the quality of the Thought Amulet, the greater the Willpower and attribute bonuses it provides
✦Thought Amulets are divided into four categories: Attack, Defense, Life, and Omni
- Attack, Defense, and Life types can only be equipped in their corresponding slots
- The Omni one can be equipped in all slots
✦Thought Amulet can be disam into Amulet Fragments

▶Yellow Signs
✦An artifact imbued with the essence of Hastur grants the wearer terrifying power
✦The affixes attached to the Yellow Sign may potentially have negative values
✦The Yellow Sign can carry multiple same affixes
✦The higher the quality of the Yellow Sign, the more attribute affixes it can carry

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/896f7ecbc19a9e36dfe06fc2ab2f0928ef987fe5.png

 ✦✦✦ Others  ✦✦✦ 
▶ Silver Key Remodel
✦The random buffs/debuffs of the Silver Key can be remodelled by using the ‘Yellow Sign.’
There is a chance to get affixes which are from additional drops or add an extra affix by remodelling
✦Higher-quality Yellow Sign have a greater chance of remodelling affixes for additional drops and are less likely to transform these affixes into ordinary buffs/debuffs
✦The Silver Key can simultaneously carry the same additional drop affixes

▶ Silver Key Infusion
✦The Silver Key can be refined using 'Amulet Fragments' obtained by dismantling the 'Thought Amulet.'
✦After refining, it can increase the drop quantity of certain items

▶Yellow Sign Synthesis
Yellow Signs can be synthesized in pairs
✦The synthesized Yellow Sign's quality will randomly fluctuate between the qualities of the two material Yellow Signs.
——For example:
Synthesizing an Advanced Yellow Sign (blue) with a Primal Yellow Sign (gold) may result in an Advanced Yellow Sign (blue), Epic Yellow Sign (purple), Legendary Yellow Sign (orange), or Primal Yellow Sign (gold).

✦The attributes of the synthesized Yellow Sign will be randomly selected from the attributes of the two material Yellow Signs, with their values remaining unchanged.

==== 【Soul Core Story】 ====
As a fragment of the self-will of Orlog, the "God of Dire," Hela is one of her many names.
Fenrir, on the other hand, is a guardian spirit born within the warrior Chaos, forged from the evil blood of the fallen gods and the holy power of Soulbane.

After the allied forces of the fallen gods led by the evil deities were utterly defeated, Hela and Chaos entered the hall of the All-Father, challenging the lofty gods.
Regrettably, the rebels' blades proved no match for the divine. Odin devoured Hela's soul with Soulbane, while Tyr severed Fenrir from Chaos's body and sealed them on Stone-South Island within the Red Black Lake...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/3b911b973bbcdf328469fd954619e03094f80698.png

Trapped within the All-Father’s body, Hela wandered in despair, ceaselessly praying for escape from the Prison of Soul. Finally, her plea was answered by an entity known as the Amorphous Lord granted her rebirth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/1d4739bd5dc114be925d0724aa00f90187771a42.png
Thus, Odin was cast into an endless cycle of torment,
while Hela the Amorphous Soul lurked within the god-king’s husk, awaiting the day of her reemergence. Meanwhile, Fenrir the Monster Wolf bided his time, poised to break free, resume his hunt for the Father of Gods, and seek his master once more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/869367e89fb578aeb261b84f57ec961d8aa35c01.png

====【Poisonous Soul Core Features】====
✦ It can cause high-level continuous poison damage to enemies.
Enemies that acquire the poison debuff status will suffer continuous poison damage per second. After the debuff bar is full, it can trigger Poisonous, enhancing the damage per second.
✦ It has the abilities of recovery and defensive counter - attack, providing a more favorable output situation for Inheritors.

For example, 
'Hela The Amorphous Soul', can summon [Ethereal Field] to block flying objects, and 'the Goddess of Youth' can provide continuous life-recovery ability.
The Affinity 'Lezard The God of The Moon' and 'Chaos the Warrior', can provide a high-level recovery and immunity to damage.
The Affinity between 'Fenrir, the Monster Wolf' and 'Chaos the Devil Lord', can provide invincibility and damage reduction for Inheritors.

✦ Affinity:
Hela The Amorphous Soul + Mimir the Wise One (Poisonous)
Increase the damage and attack speed of normal attacks, as well as boost the crit rate and pierce.

【Fenrir The Monster Wolf】

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/d22461a8efe93fbff84522b0c73349c83d36bccb.png
Poisonous/Heal Negation/SuperArmor

Meanwhile, Fenrir The Monster Wolf summons a phantom wolf for the Inheritors, which tears through enemies with Poison-attribute claw attacks. Notably, this damage cannot be healed, allowing the Inheritors to seize the initiative by dealing significant preemptive damage before closing in for melee strikes.
✦ Affinity:
Fenrir The Monster Wolf + Chaos the Devil Lord
Enhances the poison damage along with providing damage reduction and invincibility effects.
After being attacked, increase the critical crit rate and all Elemental DMG Reductions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/bc2c8f23d8078ad29898755cd0008b48bea7758f.png
Raised under the tutelage of Aesir God, Esther embarked on a journey across the mortal realm with a divine mission as one of the best Valkyrie;
However, the sight of humanity suffering under the torment of fallen gods left an indelible mark on her heart.
Ultimately, manipulated by the gods, she assassinated [Soulbane] Chaos, an act that plunged her into endless torment.
Summoned by the Dark Colossus, Esther was drawn into the void.
As an Inheritor, guided by Audhum, she now strives to restore the Colossus' Library, driven by a burning desire to redeem her past failure by dedicating to saving the world.

Unlike Chaos and Hela, Esther is a character with long-range offensive capabilities.
As a Valkyrie who wields firearms to deal damage from a distance, Esther offers a gameplay experience that emphasizes mobility and strategy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/3013a672eb99e13318f0cf045c0380d3b9cca790.png
The two newly unlocked classes for this character further diversify the play-style based on the foundation of her long-range combat template, providing a fresh and unique battle experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149847/5a042093011642ab4ad13ff2b7b6bba6f9ae3d05.png

The wide - range normal attacks of dual pistols combined with the heavy - weapon shotguns are suitable for players who love the exhilarating sense of action.
